description: Turn the live call companion on or off for every assistant of the business. On: during a call the secretary can text the caller a live page with options, open times, a details form or a deposit and hear what they tap. Payments on that page still need the business's own payments setting. Requires an admin of the business. The next call uses the change.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token has exactly one accessible business)

name: set_call_companion
title: Set Live Call Companion
